the design and implementation of novel routing algorithms and protocols for smart grid environments, and we hope to motivate the researchers to further explore this promising research area.

the smart grid environment has a significant impact on the performance of routing protocols, and the performance of routing schemes in the smart grid environment is significantly different than the performance in other environments.

the routing protocol should be designed to adapt to the smart grid environments, and the performance of the smart grid network can be improved by considering the smart grid spectrum environment in the design of the routing protocol.
